It uses only the\nRuby standard library plus SQLite, keeps all domain logic in named modules,\nand implements a tiny TCP/HTTP layer at the bottom of the file.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` is a one-line wrapper that executes `ruby server.rb`. The server\nbinds to `127.0.0.1` and reads the port from the `PORT` environment variable\n(defaulting to `3000`).\n\nVerify it is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nThe server runs in the foreground; stop it with `Ctrl-C` or by sending\n`SIGTERM` to the process.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n- `run.sh` — the launcher required by the harness.\n- `server.rb` — the only source file. It is organized from top to bottom as:\n  1. `Config` — constants (host, port, DB path, schema version).\n  2. `PureRules` — deterministic, side-effect-free game-rule helpers.\n  3. `Persistence` — SQLite schema, connection wrapper, and lifecycle helpers.\n  4. `Combat` — combat sessions, initiative, and turn/condition tracking.\n  5. `Compendium` — monster and item reference entries.\n  6. `Campaigns` — campaign metadata, characters, and event logs.\n  7. `Auth` — PBKDF2 password hashing and user storage.\n  8. `PlayerHandbook` — PHB rule helpers (spell slots, rests, encumbrance).\n  9. `DmTools` — DM-facing helpers (encounter builder, loot, session recap).\n  10. `Request` / `Response` / `Router` / `HttpServer` — transport layer.\n\nThe bottom of the file calls `HttpServer.run` when the file is executed\ndirectly.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence design\n\n- SQLite file: `game.db` in the working directory.\n- A single `Mutex` (`Persistence::DB_MUTEX`) serializes all database access.\n- `Persistence.db` yields a single shared `SQLite3::Database` connection that\n  is opened when the module loads and reused for the lifetime of the process.\n  This keeps the implementation simple and deterministic.\n- On startup the server calls `Persistence.initialize_schema!` only if the\n  schema is not already present. Existing data is preserved across restarts.\n- `Persistence.reset!` drops every application table and recreates the schema.\n  It is used by the `/v1/storage/reset` endpoint.\n\n### Request routing\n\n- Raw socket I/O: `TCPServer` accepts connections; each connection is handled\n  in its own thread so the accept loop is never blocked. `Request.parse`\n  reads a request line, headers, and optional body.\n- `Router.route` is a long `if/elsif` dispatch that matches `method + path`.\n  Path parameters are captured with anchored regexes and forced to UTF-8 so\n  SQLite binds them as text rather than blobs.\n- Connections are kept open until the client closes them, supporting HTTP/1.1\n  keep-alive without pipelining issues.\n- Domain modules return `[:tag, data]` tuples:\n  - `:ok` with a Hash body,\n  - `:invalid` for validation failures,\n  - `:not_found` for missing resources,\n  - `:conflict` for duplicate IDs.\n- `Router.handle_result` maps those tags to HTTP status codes (`200`, `201`,\n  `400`, `404`, `409`) and serializes the body as JSON.\n- Authentication endpoints (`/v1/auth/*`) are handled specially in the router\n  because `Auth` returns booleans rather than tuples. A successful login\n  returns a deterministic `session-<username>` token.\n\n## Main API/domain groupings\n\n| Group | Endpoints | Module |\n|-------|-----------|--------|\n| Core | `/health`, `/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`, `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order` | `PureRules` |\n| Characters | `/v1/characters/ability-modifier`, `/v1/characters/proficiency`, `/v1/characters/derived-stats` | `PureRules` |\n| Combat | `/v1/combat/sessions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/:id/conditions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/:id/advance` | `Combat` |\n| Auth | `/v1/auth/register`, `/v1/auth/login` | `Auth` |\n| Storage | `/v1/storage/status`, `/v1/storage/reset` | `Persistence` |\n| Compendium | `/v1/compendium/monsters`, `/v1/compendium/monsters/:slug`, `/v1/compendium/items`, `/v1/compendium/items/:slug` | `Compendium` |\n| Campaigns | `/v1/campaigns`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/characters`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/events`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/state` | `Campaigns` |\n| PHB rules | `/v1/phb/spell-slots`, `/v1/phb/rests/long`, `/v1/phb/equipment-load` | `PlayerHandbook` |\n| DM tools | `/v1/dm/encounter-builder`, `/v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `/v1/dm/session-recap` | `DmTools` |\n\n## Conventions for extending and testing\n\n### Adding a new endpoint\n\n1. If the endpoint is pure computation, put it in the appropriate domain\n   module (e.g., `PureRules`, `PlayerHandbook`, `DmTools`) and have it return\n   a Hash on success or `nil` on invalid input.\n2. If the endpoint needs persistence, add it to the module that owns the data\n   (e.g., `Combat`, `Campaigns`, `Compendium`) and return a `[:tag, data]`\n   tuple.\n3. Wire the endpoint into `Router.route` with an explicit `method`/`path` check\n   and call `handle_result` or `json_response` / `error_response` as needed.\n4. If the endpoint creates a resource, use status `201`; otherwise use `200`.\n\n### Adding a new table\n\n1. Add the `CREATE TABLE` statement to `Persistence::SCHEMA_SQL`.\n2. Add the table name to the drop list in `Persistence.reset!`.\n3. Add a module that owns reads and writes for that table.\n4. Keep validation logic private with `private_class_method`.\n\n### Testing locally\n\nBecause the server is a single file, you can run it directly:\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ruby server.rb\n```\n\nThen exercise endpoints with `curl` or any HTTP client. To reset state between\nmanual test runs, use:\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v1/storage/reset\n```\n\nFor automated regression testing, run the `dndeval` suite against the running\nserver. The cumulative `dm-tools` suite exercises every endpoint above and\nverifies the prior-stage behavior.\n\n### Determinism\n\n- Game-rule helpers are pure functions of their inputs.\n- Combat initiative uses deterministic tie-breaking (`score`, then `dex`, then\n  name).\n- `DmTools.loot_parcel` is deterministic for a given tier and seed; it does\n  not use `SecureRandom`.\n- Password hashing still uses `SecureRandom` for salts, which is correct for\n  security and does not affect the deterministic test flows that register and\n  then immediately authenticate the same user.\n\n### What to avoid\n\n- Do not introduce Rack, Rails, Sinatra, or external gems. The runtime contract\n  is Ruby stdlib + SQLite only.\n- Do not change existing response shapes, status codes, validation rules, or\n  persistence semantics for endpoints already exercised by the cumulative\n  `dm-tools` suite.\n- Keep domain modules independent of HTTP details; the `Router` is the only\n  place that knows about JSON and status codes.\n"}]},"isError":false}

Existing data is preserved across restarts.\n- `Persistence.reset!` drops every application table and recreates the schema.\n  It is used by the `/v1/storage/reset` endpoint.\n\n### Request routing\n\n- Raw socket I/O: `TCPServer` accepts connections; each connection is handled\n  in its own thread so the accept loop is never blocked. `Request.parse`\n  reads a request line, headers, and optional body.\n- `Router.route` is a long `if/elsif` dispatch that matches `method + path`.\n  Path parameters are captured with anchored regexes and forced to UTF-8 so\n  SQLite binds them as text rather than blobs.\n- Connections are kept open until the client closes them, supporting HTTP/1.1\n  keep-alive without pipelining issues.\n- Domain modules return `[:tag, data]` tuples:\n  - `:ok` with a Hash body,\n  - `:invalid` for validation failures,\n  - `:not_found` for missing resources,\n  - `:conflict` for duplicate IDs.\n- `Router.handle_result` maps those tags to HTTP status codes (`200`, `201`,\n  `400`, `404`, `409`) and serializes the body as JSON.\n- Authentication endpoints (`/v1/auth/*`) are handled specially in the router\n  because `Auth` returns booleans rather than tuples. A successful login\n  returns a deterministic `session-<username>` token.\n\n## Main API/domain groupings\n\n| Group | Endpoints | Module |\n|-------|-----------|--------|\n| Core | `/health`, `/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`, `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order` | `PureRules` |\n| Characters | `/v1/characters/ability-modifier`, `/v1/characters/proficiency`, `/v1/characters/derived-stats` | `PureRules` |\n| Combat | `/v1/combat/sessions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/:id/conditions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/:id/advance` | `Combat` |\n| Auth | `/v1/auth/register`, `/v1/auth/login` | `Auth` |\n| Storage | `/v1/storage/status`, `/v1/storage/reset` | `Persistence` |\n| Compendium | `/v1/compendium/monsters`, `/v1/compendium/monsters/:slug`, `/v1/compendium/items`, `/v1/compendium/items/:slug` | `Compendium` |\n| Campaigns | `/v1/campaigns`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/characters`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/events`, `/v1/campaigns/:id/state` | `Campaigns` |\n| PHB rules | `/v1/phb/spell-slots`, `/v1/phb/rests/long`, `/v1/phb/equipment-load` | `PlayerHandbook` |\n| DM tools | `/v1/dm/encounter-builder`, `/v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `/v1/dm/session-recap` | `DmTools` |\n\n## Conventions for extending and testing\n\n### Adding a new endpoint\n\n1. If the endpoint is pure computation, put it in the appropriate domain\n   module (e.g., `PureRules`, `PlayerHandbook`, `DmTools`) and have it return\n   a Hash on success or `nil` on invalid input.\n2. If the endpoint needs persistence, add it to the module that owns the data\n   (e.g., `Combat`, `Campaigns`, `Compendium`) and return a `[:tag, data]`\n   tuple.\n3. Wire the endpoint into `Router.route` with an explicit `method`/`path` check\n   and call `handle_result` or `json_response` / `error_response` as needed.\n4. If the endpoint creates a resource, use status `201`; otherwise use `200`.\n\n### Adding a new table\n\n1. Add the `CREATE TABLE` statement to `Persistence::SCHEMA_SQL`.\n2. Add the table name to the drop list in `Persistence.reset!`.\n3. Add a module that owns reads and writes for that table.\n4. Keep validation logic private with `private_class_method`.\n\n### Testing locally\n\nBecause the server is a single file, you can run it directly:\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ruby server.rb\n```\n\nThen exercise endpoints with `curl` or any HTTP client. To reset state between\nmanual test runs, use:\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v1/storage/reset\n```\n\nFor automated regression testing, run the `dndeval` suite against the running\nserver. The cumulative `dm-tools` suite exercises every endpoint above and\nverifies the prior-stage behavior.\n\n### Determinism\n\n- Game-rule helpers are pure functions of their inputs.\n- Combat initiative uses deterministic tie-breaking (`score`, then `dex`, then\n  name).\n- `DmTools.loot_parcel` is deterministic for a given tier and seed; it does\n  not use `SecureRandom`.\n- Password hashing still uses `SecureRandom` for salts, which is correct for\n  security and does not affect the deterministic test flows that register and\n  then immediately authenticate the same user.\n\n### What to avoid\n\n- Do not introduce Rack, Rails, Sinatra, or external gems. The runtime contract\n  is Ruby stdlib + SQLite only.\n- Do not change existing response shapes, status codes, validation rules, or\n  persistence semantics for endpoints already exercised by the cumulative\n  `dm-tools` suite.\n- Keep domain modules independent of HTTP details; the `Router` is the only\n  place that knows about JSON and status codes.\n"}],"isError":false,"timestamp":1785472245241}}

  '2' => 450,\n    '3' => 700,\n    '4' => 1100,\n    '5' => 1800\n  }.freeze\n\n  # Only level-3 party thresholds are wired in this stage; other levels\n  # make adjusted_xp return nil, matching the prior evaluator behavior.\n  THRESHOLDS = {\n    3 => { 'easy' => 75, 'medium' => 150, 'hard' => 225, 'deadly' => 400 }\n  }.freeze\n\n  DIFFICULTIES = %w[trivial easy medium hard deadly].freeze\n  ABILITIES = %w[str dex con int wis cha].freeze\n\n  def self.dice_stats(expression)\n    parsed = parse_dice_expression(expression)\n    return nil unless parsed\n\n    min = parsed[:count] + parsed[:modifier]\n    max = parsed[:count] * parsed[:sides] + parsed[:modifier]\n    average = (min + max) / 2.0\n    average = average.to_i if average == average.to_i\n\n    {\n      dice_count: parsed[:count],\n      sides: parsed[:sides],\n      modifier: parsed[:modifier],\n      min: min,\n      max: max,\n      average: average\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.ability_check(roll, modifier, dc)\n    total = roll + modifier\n    { total: total, success: total >= dc, margin: total - dc }\n  end\n\n  def self.ability_modifier(score)\n    return nil unless score.is_a?(Integer) && score >= 1 && score <= 30\n\n    (score - 10) / 2\n  end\n\n  def self.proficiency_bonus(level)\n    return nil unless level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 && level <= 20\n\n    case level\n    when 1..4 then 2\n    when 5..8 then 3\n    when 9..12 then 4\n    when 13..16 then 5\n    else 6\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.derived_stats(payload)\n    level = payload['level']\n    abilities = payload['abilities']\n    armor = payload['armor']\n\n    bonus = proficiency_bonus(level)\n    return nil unless bonus\n\n    return nil unless abilities.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    modifiers = {}\n    ABILITIES.each do |ability|\n      score = abilities[ability]\n      mod = ability_modifier(score)\n      return nil unless mod\n\n      modifiers[ability] = mod\n    end\n\n    return nil unless armor.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    base = armor['base']\n    dex_cap = armor['dex_cap']\n    shield = armor['shield']\n    return nil unless base.is_a?(Integer) && dex_cap.is_a?(Integer) && [true, false].include?(shield)\n\n    shield_bonus = shield ? 2 : 0\n    armor_class = base + [modifiers['dex'], dex_cap].min + shield_bonus\n    hp_max = level * (6 + modifiers['con'])\n\n    {\n      level: level,\n      proficiency_bonus: bonus,\n      hp_max: hp_max,\n      armor_class: armor_class,\n      modifiers: modifiers\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.adjusted_xp(party, monsters)\n    base_xp = 0\n    monster_count = 0\n\n    monsters.each do |monster|\n      cr = monster['cr']\n      count = monster['count']\n      xp = XP_TABLE[cr]\n      return nil unless xp && count.is_a?(Integer) && count > 0\n\n      base_xp += xp * count\n      monster_count += count\n    end\n\n    return nil if monster_count == 0\n\n    multiplier = format_multiplier(multiplier_for(monster_count))\n    adjusted = (base_xp * multiplier).to_i\n\n    thresholds = { 'easy' => 0, 'medium' => 0, 'hard' => 0, 'deadly' => 0 }\n    party.each do |member|\n      level = member['level']\n      th = THRESHOLDS[level]\n      return nil unless th\n\n      th.each { |k, v| thresholds[k] += v }\n    end\n\n    return nil if thresholds.values.all?(&:zero?)\n\n    {\n      base_xp: base_xp,\n      monster_count: monster_count,\n      multiplier: multiplier,\n      adjusted_xp: adjusted,\n      difficulty: difficulty_for(adjusted, thresholds),\n      thresholds: thresholds\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.initiative_order(combatants)\n    scored = combatants.map do |c|\n      { name: c['name'], score: c['roll'] + c['dex'], dex: c['dex'] }\n    end\n\n    scored.sort_by! { |c| [-c[:score], -c[:dex], c[:name]] }\n    { order: scored.map { |c| { 'name' => c[:name], 'score' => c[:score] } } }\n  end\n\n  def self.parse_dice_expression(expression)\n    return nil unless expression.is_a?(String)\n\n    match = expression.match(/\\A(\\d+)d(\\d+)(?:\\+(\\d+)|-(\\d+))?\\z/)\n    return nil unless match\n\n    count = match[1].to_i\n    sides = match[2].to_i\n    return nil if count <= 0 || sides <= 0\n\n    modifier = if match[3]\n                 match[3].to_i\n               elsif match[4]\n                 -match[4].to_i\n               else\n                 0\n               end\n\n    { count: count, sides: sides, modifier: modifier }\n  end\n  private_class_method :parse_dice_expression\n\n  def self.difficulty_for(adjusted_xp, thresholds)\n    return 'trivial' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['easy']\n    return 'easy' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['medium']\n    return 'medium' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['hard']\n    return 'hard' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['deadly']\n\n    'deadly'\n  end\n  private_class_method :difficulty_for\n\n  def self.multiplier_for(count)\n    case count\n    when 1 then 1\n    when 2 then 1.5\n    when 3..6 then 2\n    when 7..10 then 2.5\n    when 11..14 then 3\n    else 4\n    end\n  end\n  private_class_method :multiplier_for\n\n  def self.format_multiplier(m)\n    m == m.to_i ? m.to_i : m\n  end\n  private_class_method :format_multiplier\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# SQLite persistence\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Persistence\n  DB_MUTEX = Mutex.new\n\n  SCHEMA_SQL = <<~SQL\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n      username TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      role TEXT NOT NULL,\n      salt TEXT NOT NULL,\n      hash TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS combat_sessions (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      round INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      turn_index INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      order_json TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS combat_conditions (\n      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n      session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      target TEXT NOT NULL,\n      condition TEXT NOT NULL,\n      remaining_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conditions_session_target ON combat_conditions(session_id, target);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compendium_monsters (\n      slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      cr TEXT NOT NULL,\n      armor_class INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      hit_points INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      tags_json TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compendium_items (\n      slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      type TEXT NOT NULL,\n      rarity TEXT NOT NULL,\n      cost_gp INTEGER NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compendium_monsters_slug ON compendium_monsters(slug);\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compendium_items_slug ON compendium_items(slug);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_meta (\n      key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      value TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_meta (key, value) VALUES ('schema_version', '#{Config::SCHEMA_VERSION}');\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaigns (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      dm TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_characters (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      class TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_events (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      kind TEXT NOT NULL,\n      summary TEXT\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_characters_campaign ON campaign_characters(campaign_id);\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_events_campaign ON campaign_events(campaign_id);\n  SQL\n\n  # Opens a new SQLite connection per request and serializes access with a\n  # global mutex. This keeps the implementation simple and deterministic.\n  def self.db\n    DB_MUTEX.synchronize do\n      database = SQLite3::Database.new(Config::DB_PATH)\n      database.busy_timeout = 1000\n      database.results_as_hash = false\n      begin\n        yield database\n      ensure\n        database.close\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.schema_initialized?\n    db { |d| d.get_first_value(\"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='users'\") } ? true : false\n  end\n\n  def self.initialize_schema!\n    db { |d| d.execute_batch(SCHEMA_SQL) }\n  end\n\n  def self.reset!\n    db do |d|\n      %w[combat_conditions combat_sessions compendium_monsters compendium_items users\n         campaigns campaign_characters campaign_events schema_meta].each do |table|\n        d.execute(\"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #{table}\")\n      end\n      d.execute_batch(SCHEMA_SQL)\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.status\n    {\n      driver: 'sqlite',\n      schema_version: Config::SCHEMA_VERSION,\n      initialized: schema_initialized?\n    }\n  end\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Combat state: sessions, initiative, and conditions\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Combat\n  def self.create_session(payload)\n    parsed = parse_combat_session(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless parsed\n\n    session_id, order = parsed\n    order_json = JSON.generate(order)\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:invalid] if existing\n\n      d.execute('INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index, order_json) VALUES (?, 1, 0, ?)', [session_id, order_json])\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => session_id,\n        'round' => 1,\n        'turn_index' => 0,\n        'active' => order[0],\n        'order' => order\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.add_condition(session_id, payload)\n    target = payload['target']\n    condition = payload['condition']\n    duration = payload['duration_rounds']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless target.is_a?(String) && !target.empty? &&\n                             condition.is_a?(String) &&\n                             duration.is_a?(Integer) && duration > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT order_json FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      order = JSON.parse(row[0])\n      next [:invalid] unless order.any? { |c| c['name'] == target }\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO combat_conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining_rounds) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [session_id, target, condition, duration]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'target' => target,\n        'conditions' => fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Conditions decrement at the *start* of a target's turn and are removed\n  # when their remaining duration drops to zero. The response echoes the full\n  # condition map so callers can see every combatant's state.\n  def self.advance_turn(session_id)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT round, turn_index, order_json FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      round, turn_index, order_json = row\n      order = JSON.parse(order_json)\n      count = order.length\n\n      new_turn_index = (turn_index + 1) % count\n      new_round = round + (new_turn_index == 0 ? 1 : 0)\n\n      active_name = order[new_turn_index]['name']\n\n      d.execute('SELECT id, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ?', [session_id, active_name]).each do |cond_id, remaining_rounds|\n        new_remaining = remaining_rounds - 1\n        if new_remaining <= 0\n          d.execute('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?', cond_id)\n        else\n          d.execute('UPDATE combat_conditions SET remaining_rounds = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_remaining, cond_id])\n        end\n      end\n\n      d.execute('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_round, new_turn_index, session_id])\n\n      conditions = order.each_with_object({}) { |c, h| h[c['name']] = [] }\n      d.execute('SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id', session_id).each do |target, condition, remaining_rounds|\n        conditions[target] ||= []\n        conditions[target] << { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => session_id,\n        'round' => new_round,\n        'turn_index' => new_turn_index,\n        'active' => order[new_turn_index],\n        'conditions' => conditions\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.parse_combat_session(payload)\n    session_id = payload['id']\n    return nil unless session_id.is_a?(String) && !session_id.empty?\n\n    combatants = payload['combatants']\n    return nil unless combatants.is_a?(Array) && !combatants.empty?\n\n    parsed = combatants.map do |c|\n      return nil unless c.is_a?(Hash) &&\n                        c['name'].is_a?(String) && !c['name'].empty? &&\n                        c['dex'].is_a?(Integer) &&\n                        c['roll'].is_a?(Integer)\n\n      { name: c['name'], score: c['roll'] + c['dex'], dex: c['dex'] }\n    end\n\n    parsed.sort_by! { |c| [-c[:score], -c[:dex], c[:name]] }\n    order = parsed.map { |c| { 'name' => c[:name], 'score' => c[:score] } }\n\n    [session_id, order]\n  end\n  private_class_method :parse_combat_session\n\n  def self.fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n    d.execute(\n      'SELECT condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ? ORDER BY id',\n      [session_id, target]\n    ).map do |condition, remaining_rounds|\n      { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n    end\n  end\n  private_class_method :fetch_conditions_for_target\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Compendium: monsters and items\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Compendium\n  def self.create_monster(payload)\n    data = validate_monster(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM compendium_monsters WHERE slug = ?', data[:slug])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO compendium_monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:slug], data[:name], data[:cr], data[:armor_class], data[:hit_points], JSON.generate(data[:tags])]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'slug' => data[:slug],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'cr' => data[:cr],\n        'armor_class' => data[:armor_class],\n        'hit_points' => data[:hit_points]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.read_monster(slug)\n    return [:invalid] unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json FROM compendium_monsters WHERE slug = ?',\n        slug\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json = row\n      tags = JSON.parse(tags_json) rescue []\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'slug' => slug,\n        'name' => name,\n        'cr' => cr,\n        'armor_class' => armor_class,\n        'hit_points' => hit_points,\n        'tags' => tags\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_item(payload)\n    data = validate_item(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM compendium_items WHERE slug = ?', data[:slug])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO compendium_items (slug, name, type, rarity, cost_gp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:slug], data[:name], data[:type], data[:rarity], data[:cost_gp]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'slug' => data[:slug],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'type' => data[:type],\n        'rarity' => data[:rarity],\n        'cost_gp' => data[:cost_gp]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.read_item(slug)\n    return [:invalid] unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT name, type, rarity, cost_gp FROM compendium_items WHERE slug = ?',\n        slug\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      name, type, rarity, cost_gp = row\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'slug' => slug,\n        'name' => name,\n        'type' => type,\n        'rarity' => rarity,\n        'cost_gp' => cost_gp\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_monster(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    slug = payload['slug']\n    name = payload['name']\n    cr = payload['cr']\n    armor_class = payload['armor_class']\n    hit_points = payload['hit_points']\n    tags = payload['tags']\n\n    return nil unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      cr.is_a?(String) && !cr.empty? &&\n                      armor_class.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      hit_points.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      tags.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      tags.all? { |t| t.is_a?(String) }\n\n    {\n      slug: slug,\n      name: name,\n      cr: cr,\n      armor_class: armor_class,\n      hit_points: hit_points,\n      tags: tags\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_monster\n\n  def self.validate_item(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    slug = payload['slug']\n    name = payload['name']\n    type = payload['type']\n    rarity = payload['rarity']\n    cost_gp = payload['cost_gp']\n\n    return nil unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      type.is_a?(String) && !type.empty? &&\n                      rarity.is_a?(String) && !rarity.empty? &&\n                      cost_gp.is_a?(Integer)\n\n    {\n      slug: slug,\n      name: name,\n      type: type,\n      rarity: rarity,\n      cost_gp: cost_gp\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_item\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Campaigns: state, characters, and session logs\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Campaigns\n  def self.create(payload)\n    data = validate_campaign(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaigns (id, name, dm) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], data[:name], data[:dm]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'dm' => data[:dm]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_character(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_character(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_characters (id, campaign_id, name, level, class) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:name], data[:level], data[:class]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'level' => data[:level],\n        'class' => data[:class]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_event(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_event(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_events WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_events (id, campaign_id, kind, summary) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:kind], data[:summary]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'kind' => data[:kind]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.state(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT name, dm FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      name, dm = row\n\n      characters = d.execute(\n        'SELECT id, name, level, class FROM campaign_characters WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY id',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map do |id, char_name, level, klass|\n        { 'id' => id, 'name' => char_name, 'level' => level, 'class' => klass }\n      end\n\n      log_count = d.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ?', campaign_id)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => campaign_id,\n        'name' => name,\n        'dm' => dm,\n        'characters' => characters,\n        'log_count' => log_count\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_campaign(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    dm = payload['dm']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      dm.is_a?(String) && !dm.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, dm: dm }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_campaign\n\n  def self.validate_character(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    level = payload['level']\n    klass = payload['class']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 && level <= 20 &&\n                      klass.is_a?(String) && !klass.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, level: level, class: klass }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_character\n\n  def self.validate_event(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    kind = payload['kind']\n    summary = payload['summary']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      kind.is_a?(String) && !kind.empty? &&\n                      (summary.nil? || summary.is_a?(String))\n\n    { id: id, kind: kind, summary: summary }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_event\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Authentication (PBKDF2 password hashing)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Auth\n  VALID_ROLES = %w[dm player].freeze\n  USERNAME_RE = /\\A[a-z0-9_-]{2,32}\\z/.freeze\n  PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 210_000\n  HASH_BYTES = 32\n  SALT_BYTES = 16\n\n  def self.valid_username?(username)\n    username.is_a?(String) && username.match?(USERNAME_RE)\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_password?(password)\n    password.is_a?(String) && password.bytesize >= 8\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_role?(role)\n    VALID_ROLES.include?(role)\n  end\n\n  def self.register_user(username, password, role)\n    creds = dc)\n    total = roll + modifier\n    { total: total, success: total >= dc, margin: total - dc }\n  end\n\n  def self.ability_modifier(score)\n    return nil unless score.is_a?(Integer) && score >= 1 && score <= 30\n\n    (score - 10) / 2\n  end\n\n  def self.proficiency_bonus(level)\n    return nil unless level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 && level <= 20\n\n    case level\n    when 1..4 then 2\n    when 5..8 then 3\n    when 9..12 then 4\n    when 13..16 then 5\n    else 6\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.derived_stats(payload)\n    level = payload['level']\n    abilities = payload['abilities']\n    armor = payload['armor']\n\n    bonus = proficiency_bonus(level)\n    return nil unless bonus\n\n    return nil unless abilities.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    modifiers = {}\n    ABILITIES.each do |ability|\n      score = abilities[ability]\n      mod = ability_modifier(score)\n      return nil unless mod\n\n      modifiers[ability] = mod\n    end\n\n    return nil unless armor.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    base = armor['base']\n    dex_cap = armor['dex_cap']\n    shield = armor['shield']\n    return nil unless base.is_a?(Integer) && dex_cap.is_a?(Integer) && [true, false].include?(shield)\n\n    shield_bonus = shield ? 2 : 0\n    armor_class = base + [modifiers['dex'], dex_cap].min + shield_bonus\n    hp_max = level * (6 + modifiers['con'])\n\n    {\n      level: level,\n      proficiency_bonus: bonus,\n      hp_max: hp_max,\n      armor_class: armor_class,\n      modifiers: modifiers\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.adjusted_xp(party, monsters)\n    base_xp = 0\n    monster_count = 0\n\n    monsters.each do |monster|\n      cr = monster['cr']\n      count = monster['count']\n      xp = XP_TABLE[cr]\n      return nil unless xp && count.is_a?(Integer) && count > 0\n\n      base_xp += xp * count\n      monster_count += count\n    end\n\n    return nil if monster_count == 0\n\n    multiplier = format_multiplier(multiplier_for(monster_count))\n    adjusted = (base_xp * multiplier).to_i\n\n    thresholds = { 'easy' => 0, 'medium' => 0, 'hard' => 0, 'deadly' => 0 }\n    party.each do |member|\n      level = member['level']\n      th = THRESHOLDS[level]\n      return nil unless th\n\n      th.each { |k, v| thresholds[k] += v }\n    end\n\n    return nil if thresholds.values.all?(&:zero?)\n\n    {\n      base_xp: base_xp,\n      monster_count: monster_count,\n      multiplier: multiplier,\n      adjusted_xp: adjusted,\n      difficulty: difficulty_for(adjusted, thresholds),\n      thresholds: thresholds\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.initiative_order(combatants)\n    scored = combatants.map do |c|\n      { name: c['name'], score: c['roll'] + c['dex'], dex: c['dex'] }\n    end\n\n    scored.sort_by! { |c| [-c[:score], -c[:dex], c[:name]] }\n    { order: scored.map { |c| { 'name' => c[:name], 'score' => c[:score] } } }\n  end\n\n  def self.parse_dice_expression(expression)\n    return nil unless expression.is_a?(String)\n\n    match = expression.match(/\\A(\\d+)d(\\d+)(?:\\+(\\d+)|-(\\d+))?\\z/)\n    return nil unless match\n\n    count = match[1].to_i\n    sides = match[2].to_i\n    return nil if count <= 0 || sides <= 0\n\n    modifier = if match[3]\n                 match[3].to_i\n               elsif match[4]\n                 -match[4].to_i\n               else\n                 0\n               end\n\n    { count: count, sides: sides, modifier: modifier }\n  end\n  private_class_method :parse_dice_expression\n\n  def self.difficulty_for(adjusted_xp, thresholds)\n    return 'trivial' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['easy']\n    return 'easy' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['medium']\n    return 'medium' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['hard']\n    return 'hard' if adjusted_xp < thresholds['deadly']\n\n    'deadly'\n  end\n  private_class_method :difficulty_for\n\n  def self.multiplier_for(count)\n    case count\n    when 1 then 1\n    when 2 then 1.5\n    when 3..6 then 2\n    when 7..10 then 2.5\n    when 11..14 then 3\n    else 4\n    end\n  end\n  private_class_method :multiplier_for\n\n  def self.format_multiplier(m)\n    m == m.to_i ? m.to_i : m\n  end\n  private_class_method :format_multiplier\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# SQLite persistence\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Persistence\n  DB_MUTEX = Mutex.new\n\n  SCHEMA_SQL = <<~SQL\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n      username TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      role TEXT NOT NULL,\n      salt TEXT NOT NULL,\n      hash TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS combat_sessions (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      round INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      turn_index INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      order_json TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS combat_conditions (\n      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n      session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      target TEXT NOT NULL,\n      condition TEXT NOT NULL,\n      remaining_rounds INTEGER NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_conditions_session_target ON combat_conditions(session_id, target);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compendium_monsters (\n      slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      cr TEXT NOT NULL,\n      armor_class INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      hit_points INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      tags_json TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS compendium_items (\n      slug TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      type TEXT NOT NULL,\n      rarity TEXT NOT NULL,\n      cost_gp INTEGER NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compendium_monsters_slug ON compendium_monsters(slug);\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_compendium_items_slug ON compendium_items(slug);\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_meta (\n      key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      value TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_meta (key, value) VALUES ('schema_version', '#{Config::SCHEMA_VERSION}');\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaigns (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      dm TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_characters (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      name TEXT NOT NULL,\n      level INTEGER NOT NULL,\n      class TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_events (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      kind TEXT NOT NULL,\n      summary TEXT\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_characters_campaign ON campaign_characters(campaign_id);\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_events_campaign ON campaign_events(campaign_id);\n  SQL\n\n  # Opens a new SQLite connection per request and serializes access with a\n  # global mutex. This keeps the implementation simple and deterministic.\n  def self.db\n    DB_MUTEX.synchronize do\n      database = SQLite3::Database.new(Config::DB_PATH)\n      database.busy_timeout = 1000\n      database.results_as_hash = false\n      begin\n        yield database\n      ensure\n        database.close\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.schema_initialized?\n    db { |d| d.get_first_value(\"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='users'\") } ? true : false\n  end\n\n  def self.initialize_schema!\n    db { |d| d.execute_batch(SCHEMA_SQL) }\n  end\n\n  def self.reset!\n    db do |d|\n      %w[combat_conditions combat_sessions compendium_monsters compendium_items users\n         campaigns campaign_characters campaign_events schema_meta].each do |table|\n        d.execute(\"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #{table}\")\n      end\n      d.execute_batch(SCHEMA_SQL)\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.status\n    {\n      driver: 'sqlite',\n      schema_version: Config::SCHEMA_VERSION,\n      initialized: schema_initialized?\n    }\n  end\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Combat state: sessions, initiative, and conditions\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Combat\n  def self.create_session(payload)\n    parsed = parse_combat_session(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless parsed\n\n    session_id, order = parsed\n    order_json = JSON.generate(order)\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:invalid] if existing\n\n      d.execute('INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index, order_json) VALUES (?, 1, 0, ?)', [session_id, order_json])\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => session_id,\n        'round' => 1,\n        'turn_index' => 0,\n        'active' => order[0],\n        'order' => order\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.add_condition(session_id, payload)\n    target = payload['target']\n    condition = payload['condition']\n    duration = payload['duration_rounds']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless target.is_a?(String) && !target.empty? &&\n                             condition.is_a?(String) &&\n                             duration.is_a?(Integer) && duration > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT order_json FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      order = JSON.parse(row[0])\n      next [:invalid] unless order.any? { |c| c['name'] == target }\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO combat_conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining_rounds) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [session_id, target, condition, duration]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'target' => target,\n        'conditions' => fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Conditions decrement at the *start* of a target's turn and are removed\n  # when their remaining duration drops to zero. The response echoes the full\n  # condition map so callers can see every combatant's state.\n  def self.advance_turn(session_id)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT round, turn_index, order_json FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      round, turn_index, order_json = row\n      order = JSON.parse(order_json)\n      count = order.length\n\n      new_turn_index = (turn_index + 1) % count\n      new_round = round + (new_turn_index == 0 ? 1 : 0)\n\n      active_name = order[new_turn_index]['name']\n\n      d.execute('SELECT id, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ?', [session_id, active_name]).each do |cond_id, remaining_rounds|\n        new_remaining = remaining_rounds - 1\n        if new_remaining <= 0\n          d.execute('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?', cond_id)\n        else\n          d.execute('UPDATE combat_conditions SET remaining_rounds = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_remaining, cond_id])\n        end\n      end\n\n      d.execute('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_round, new_turn_index, session_id])\n\n      conditions = order.each_with_object({}) { |c, h| h[c['name']] = [] }\n      d.execute('SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id', session_id).each do |target, condition, remaining_rounds|\n        conditions[target] ||= []\n        conditions[target] << { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => session_id,\n        'round' => new_round,\n        'turn_index' => new_turn_index,\n        'active' => order[new_turn_index],\n        'conditions' => conditions\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.parse_combat_session(payload)\n    session_id = payload['id']\n    return nil unless session_id.is_a?(String) && !session_id.empty?\n\n    combatants = payload['combatants']\n    return nil unless combatants.is_a?(Array) && !combatants.empty?\n\n    parsed = combatants.map do |c|\n      return nil unless c.is_a?(Hash) &&\n                        c['name'].is_a?(String) && !c['name'].empty? &&\n                        c['dex'].is_a?(Integer) &&\n                        c['roll'].is_a?(Integer)\n\n      { name: c['name'], score: c['roll'] + c['dex'], dex: c['dex'] }\n    end\n\n    parsed.sort_by! { |c| [-c[:score], -c[:dex], c[:name]] }\n    order = parsed.map { |c| { 'name' => c[:name], 'score' => c[:score] } }\n\n    [session_id, order]\n  end\n  private_class_method :parse_combat_session\n\n  def self.fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n    d.execute(\n      'SELECT condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ? ORDER BY id',\n      [session_id, target]\n    ).map do |condition, remaining_rounds|\n      { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n    end\n  end\n  private_class_method :fetch_conditions_for_target\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Compendium: monsters and items\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Compendium\n  def self.create_monster(payload)\n    data = validate_monster(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless      'slug' => data[:slug],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'type' => data[:type],\n        'rarity' => data[:rarity],\n        'cost_gp' => data[:cost_gp]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.read_item(slug)\n    return [:invalid] unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT name, type, rarity, cost_gp FROM compendium_items WHERE slug = ?',\n        slug\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      name, type, rarity, cost_gp = row\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'slug' => slug,\n        'name' => name,\n        'type' => type,\n        'rarity' => rarity,\n        'cost_gp' => cost_gp\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_monster(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    slug = payload['slug']\n    name = payload['name']\n    cr = payload['cr']\n    armor_class = payload['armor_class']\n    hit_points = payload['hit_points']\n    tags = payload['tags']\n\n    return nil unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      cr.is_a?(String) && !cr.empty? &&\n                      armor_class.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      hit_points.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      tags.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      tags.all? { |t| t.is_a?(String) }\n\n    {\n      slug: slug,\n      name: name,\n      cr: cr,\n      armor_class: armor_class,\n      hit_points: hit_points,\n      tags: tags\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_monster\n\n  def self.validate_item(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    slug = payload['slug']\n    name = payload['name']\n    type = payload['type']\n    rarity = payload['rarity']\n    cost_gp = payload['cost_gp']\n\n    return nil unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      type.is_a?(String) && !type.empty? &&\n                      rarity.is_a?(String) && !rarity.empty? &&\n                      cost_gp.is_a?(Integer)\n\n    {\n      slug: slug,\n      name: name,\n      type: type,\n      rarity: rarity,\n      cost_gp: cost_gp\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_item\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Campaigns: state, characters, and session logs\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Campaigns\n  def self.create(payload)\n    data = validate_campaign(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaigns (id, name, dm) VALUES (?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], data[:name], data[:dm]]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'name' => data[:name],\n        'dm' => data[:dm]\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_character(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_character(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_event(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_events (id, campaign_id, kind, summary) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT name, dm FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] ORDER BY id',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map do |id, char_name, level, klass|\n        { 'id' => id, 'name' => char_name, 'level' => level, 'class' => klass }\n      end\n\n      log_count =   name = payload['name']\n    dm = payload['dm']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      dm.is_a?(String) && !dm.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, dm: dm }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_campaign\n\n  def self.validate_character(payload)\n    return nil unless                name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 && level <= 20 &&\n                      klass.is_a?(String) && !klass.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, level: level, class: klass }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_character\n\n  def self.validate_event(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    kind = payload['kind']\n    summary = payload['summary']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      kind.is_a?(String) && !kind.empty? &&\n                      (summary.nil? || summary.is_a?(String))\n\n    { id: id, kind: kind, summary: summary }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_event\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Authentication (PBKDF2 password hashing)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Auth\n  VALID_ROLES = %w[dm player].freeze\n  USERNAME_RE = /\\A[a-z0-9_-]{2,32}\\z/.freeze\n  PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 210_000\n  HASH_BYTES = 32\n  SALT_BYTES = 16\n\n  def self.valid_username?(username)\n    username.is_a?(String) && username.match?(USERNAME_RE)\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_password?(password)\n    password.is_a?(String) && password.bytesize >= 8\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_role?(role)\n    VALID_ROLES.include?(role)\n  end\n\n  def self.register_user(username, password, role)\n    creds = hash_password(password)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = ?', username)\n      next false if existing\n\n      d.execute('INSERT INTO users (username, role, salt, hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', [username, role, creds[:salt], creds[:hash]])\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.authenticate_user(username, password)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT salt, hash FROM users WHERE username = ?', username)\n      next false unless row\n\n      verify_password(password, row[0], row[1])\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.hash_password(password)\n    salt = SecureRandom.random_bytes(SALT_BYTES)\n    hash = OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(\n      password,\n      salt: salt,\n      iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,\n      length: HASH_BYTES,\n      hash: 'sha256'\n    )\n    { salt: Base64.strict_encode64(salt), hash: Base64.strict_encode64(hash) }\n  end\n  private_class_method :hash_password\n\n  def self.verify_password(password, salt_b64, hash_b64)\n    salt = Base64.strict_decode64(salt_b64)\n    expected = Base64.strict_decode64(hash_b64)\n    actual = It uses only the\nRuby standard library plus SQLite, keeps all domain logic in named modules,\nand implements a tiny TCP/HTTP layer at the bottom of the file.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` is a one-line wrapper that executes `ruby server.rb`. The server\nbinds to `127.0.0.1` and reads the port from the `PORT` environment variable\n(defaulting to `3000`).\n\nVerify it is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nThe server runs in the foreground; stop it with `Ctrl-C` or by sending\n`SIGTERM` to the process.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n- `run.sh` — the launcher required by the harness.\n- `server.rb` — the only source file. It is organized from top to bottom as:\n  1. `Config` — constants (host, port, DB path, schema version).\n  2. `PureRules` — deterministic, side-effect-free game-rule helpers.\n  3. `Persistence` — SQLite schema, connection wrapper, and lifecycle helpers.\n  4. `Combat` — combat sessions, initiative, and turn/condition tracking.\n  5. `Compendium` — monster and item reference entries.\n  6. `Campaigns` — campaign metadata, characters, and event logs.\n  7. `Auth` — PBKDF2 password hashing and user storage.\n  8. `PlayerHandbook` — PHB rule helpers (spell slots, rests, encumbrance).\n  9. `DmTools` — DM-facing helpers (encounter builder, loot, session recap).\n  10. `Request` / `Response` / `Router` / `HttpServer` — transport layer.\n\nThe bottom of the file calls `HttpServer.run` when the file is executed\ndirectly.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence design\n\n- SQLite file: `game.db` in the working directory.\n- A single `Mutex` (`Persistence::DB_MUTEX`) serializes all database access.\n- Every call to `Persistence.db` opens a fresh `SQLite3::Database`, yields it,\n  and closes it in an `ensure` block. This avoids connection-state bugs while\n  keeping the server safe for single-threaded or multi-threaded use.\n- On startup the server calls `Persistence.initialize_schema!` only if the\n  schema is not already present. If the endpoint needs persistence, add it to the module that owns the data\n   (e.g., `Combat`, `Campaigns`, `Compendium`) and return a `[:tag, data]`\n   tuple.\n3. If the endpoint creates a resource, use status `201`; otherwise use `200`.\n\n### Adding a new table\n\n1. Add the `CREATE TABLE` statement to `Persistence::SCHEMA_SQL`.\n2. Add the table name to the drop list in `Persistence.reset!`.\n3. Add a module that owns reads and writes for that table.\n4. Keep validation logic private with `private_class_method`.\n\n### Testing locally\n\nBecause the server is a single file, you can run it directly:\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ruby server.rb\n```\n\nThen exercise endpoints with `curl` or any HTTP client. It uses only the\nRuby standard library plus SQLite, keeps all domain logic in named modules,\nand implements a tiny TCP/HTTP layer at the bottom of the file.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=3000 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` is a one-line wrapper that executes `ruby server.rb`. The server\nbinds to `127.0.0.1` and reads the port from the `PORT` environment variable\n(defaulting to `3000`).\n\nVerify it is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nThe server runs in the foreground; stop it with `Ctrl-C` or by sending\n`SIGTERM` to the process.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n- `run.sh` — the launcher required by the harness.\n- `server.rb` — the only source file. It is organized from top to bottom as:\n  1. `Config` — constants (host, port, DB path, schema version).\n  2. `PureRules` — deterministic, side-effect-free game-rule helpers.\n  3. `Persistence` — SQLite schema, connection wrapper, and lifecycle helpers.\n  4. `Combat` — combat sessions, initiative, and turn/condition tracking.\n  5. `Compendium` — monster and item reference entries.\n  6. `Campaigns` — campaign metadata, characters, and event logs.\n  7. `Auth` — PBKDF2 password hashing and user storage.\n  8. `PlayerHandbook` — PHB rule helpers (spell slots, rests, encumbrance).\n  9. `DmTools` — DM-facing helpers (encounter builder, loot, session recap).\n  10. `Request` / `Response` / `Router` / `HttpServer` — transport layer.\n\nThe bottom of the file calls `HttpServer.run` when the file is executed\ndirectly.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing\n\n### Persistence design\n\n- SQLite file: `game.db` in the working directory.\n- A single `Mutex` (`Persistence::DB_MUTEX`) serializes all database access.\n- `Persistence.db` yields a single shared `SQLite3::Database` connection that\n  is opened when the module loads and reused for the lifetime of the process.\n  This keeps the implementation simple and deterministic.\n- On startup the server calls `Persistence.initialize_schema!` only if the\n  schema is not already present.
